summary: The exact base reproduces the reported Responses-to-Chat adapter validation failure for explicit JSON null. The exact candidate normalizes only that null adapter value to false, preserves omitted/false/true behavior, and passes its focused regression plus the related serving/protocol suites.

tests.what_was_measured: The actual source-checkout OpenAIServingResponses._make_request path reproduced Pydantic bool_type for stream=null; omitted, false, and true succeeded. The probe itself exits zero after recording each case.
The same independent adapter-path cases succeeded at the exact candidate; null became false and explicit boolean behavior was preserved.
Candidate-authored issue-specific regression passed: 1 test and 3 subtests.
Related Responses serving and protocol coverage passed: 57 tests and 5 subtests.

gpu_execution_evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X was visible through Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2/HIP 7.2.26015, but independent model generation was not needed or claimed for this pre-generation request-validation defect.
remaining_limitations: The reported DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 weights and architecture were unavailable, so that model configuration was not independently reproduced.

sgl-model-gateway was not present in the prepared checkout; its forwarding process was not run, while its relevant output shape was exercised as exact JSON null against SGLang's actual request adapter.

No independent HTTP model-serving run was performed; the failure and fix were verified directly in the pre-generation adapter path, and the candidate's retained GPU-serving artifacts were not treated as independent proof.
The candidate has no native-source changes, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
